title: SaaS Security per-application capabilities: onboarding privileges, webhooks, historical scan, licensing, scanned content, actions and activities

prose.text: The Understanding SaaS Security Supported Capabilities article is a per-application matrix. {{matrix-columns}}

prose.label: Public cloud storage and source code repositories.
Email, CRM, ITSM and Gen AI.
What the matrix leaves open.
prose.text: What the Historical Scan values mean is open {{gap:historical-scan-meaning}}. The Smartsheet and ChatGPT cells are open {{gap:matrix-cell-oddities}}. How far back a scan may reach is also in [[zia.casb.scans]].

prose.label: Actions.

checks.do: Whether the application's licensing and onboarding privilege in the matrix are met before concluding a tenant cannot be onboarded.
Whether the application's Actions row offers the action a rule needs, since remediation differs by application.

matrix-columns.statement: The article lists the supported administrative capabilities and actions for all SaaS Security applications; its capability table has per-application columns Onboarding Privileges, Webhooks, Historical Scan, Malware Support, Incident Management (Workflow Automation), Activity Alerts and Monitoring and Licensing.

quotes: This article lists the supported administrative capabilities and actions for all SaaS Security applications:
| Application | Onboarding Privileges | Webhooks | Historical Scan | Malware Support | Incident Management (Workflow Automation) | Activity Alerts and Monitoring | Licensing

collaboration.statement: In the capability table Zoom needs Owner, supports webhooks, scans 1 month and needs Zoom Pro or above; MS Teams needs Admin, Teams, and SharePoint Admin, supports webhooks, scans 6 months and lists a minimum of Microsoft 365 Business Standard with Teams Activity Report if Audit (Standard) is bundled, also working with E3 and E5; Slack needs Org Admin, does not support webhooks, scans 6 years and needs Slack Enterprise Grid; Cisco Webex needs Admin, supports webhooks, scans 15 days and lists a Webex calling License, with a Webex Pro License for real time.

quotes: Zoom | Owner | Supported | 1 month | Supported | Supported | Supported | Zoom Pro or above

MS Teams | Admin, Teams, and SharePoint Admin | Supported | 6 months | Supported | Supported | Supported | Min - Microsoft 365 Business Standard with Teams Activity Report would work if Audit (Standard) is bundled Works with E3 and E5 also
Slack | Org Admin | Not Supported | 6 years | Supported | Supported | Supported | Slack Enterprise Grid
Cisco Webex | Admin | Supported | 15 days | Supported | Supported | Supported | Webex calling License, Webex Real Time Support : Webex Pro License

file-share.statement: In the capability table OneDrive and SharePoint need Global Admin, SharePoint Admin, support webhooks, scan 6 years and list Min - Microsoft 365 Business Standard with Teams Activity Report would work if Audit (Standard) is bundled, Works with E3 and E5 also; Google Drive needs Super Admin or Custom Role Admin (the row says to check the custom connector), supports webhooks, scans 6 years and needs Google Enterprise or above; Box (1 year, Box Enterprise License) and ShareFile (4 years, ShareFile Enterprise Industry License) need Admin and do not support webhooks; Smartsheet needs Admin, does not support webhooks, scans 30 days, and its activity cell reads Supported (Alerts and Monitoring only) with Smartsheet Enterprise with event reporting plugin; Confluence and Dropbox need Admin, support webhooks, scan 5 years and need their Enterprise licenses.

cloud-storage-and-repos.statement: In the capability table Amazon S3 Bucket needs Admin, supports webhooks, scans 1 year and lists Free Tier and above; Azure Storage Account needs Storage Account Contributions, does not support webhooks, scans 1 year and lists Pay as you go; GCP needs Org Admin, supports webhooks, scans 1 year and lists Free Tier and above; GitHub needs Admin, does not support webhooks, scans 5 years and needs GitHub Enterprise Cloud; GitLab and Bitbucket need Admin, support webhooks, scan 5 years and need Premium licenses.

email-crm-itsm-genai.statement: In the capability table Exchange (Admin, Exchange Admin) and Gmail (Super Admin, Custom Role) support webhooks and scan 6 years; Salesforce (Admin) and Dynamics 365 CRM (Admin) do not support webhooks and scan 6 years, with Salesforce working with the Enterprise, Unlimited, Performance, Developer and SandBox editions and needing the Event Monitoring add-on for the Activity Report; Jira needs Admin, supports webhooks, scans 1 year and needs Jira Enterprise; ServiceNow needs Not Necessary, does not support webhooks, scans 6 years and works with all licenses; ChatGPT needs Admin, does not support webhooks, scans 6 years, and its activity cell and licensing cell read Not Supported.

scan-content.statement: The Actions table gives each application's scanned content, for example Slack channels (messages and attachments) and 1:1 chats, Amazon S3 buckets and files, GitHub commit files within those repos with repositories only with organizations, Salesforce files, cases and Chatter body, ServiceNow tables (tasks, incident, change, problem, etc.) and attachments, and ChatGPT messages, files uploaded and files generated by ChatGPT.

GitHub | Commit Files Within Those Repos Repositories Only with Organizations
Salesforce | Files Cases Chatter Body
ServiceNow | Tables (Tasks, Incident, Change, Problem, etc.) Attachments
ChatGPT | Messages, Files Uploaded, and Files Generated by ChatGPT

remediation-examples.statement: Actions differ by application in the Actions table: the MS Teams row lists Notify Users and Report Incident, then None, then Quarantine Malware (Files), Remove Malware and Report Malware; Amazon S3 Bucket lists Remove Public Shareable Link and Report Incident, then None; Azure Storage Account lists Report Incident, then None; GitHub lists Report Incident twice and Report Malware; ChatGPT lists Report Incident, then None, then Report Malware.

quotes: MS Teams | Channels: Messages and Attachments | Notify Users Report Incident | None | Quarantine Malware (Files) Remove Malware Report Malware
Amazon S3 Bucket | Buckets Files | Remove Public Shareable Link Report Incident | None | Quarantine Malware Remove Malware Report Malware
Azure Storage Account | Storage Accounts Containers Files (blobs) | Report Incident | None | Quarantine Malware Remove Malware Report Malware
GitHub | Commit Files Within Those Repos Repositories Only with Organizations | Report Incident | Report Incident | Report Malware
ChatGPT | Messages, Files Uploaded, and Files Generated by ChatGPT | Report Incident | None | Report Malware

activities.statement: The article says Activities is currently not supported for the Smartsheet application; its Activities table lists, for example, Slack user activities Create, Delete, Download, Login Fail, Login Pass, Move, Upload and Share Link and GitHub user activities Create, Fork, Pull Request and Share with NA for admins.

historical-scan-meaning.title: What the Historical Scan values mean
historical-scan-meaning.detail: The matrix gives values from 15 days to 6 years per application. The article does not say whether a value is a maximum look-back or a default.

matrix-cell-oddities.title: Smartsheet activity support and ChatGPT licensing in the matrix
matrix-cell-oddities.detail: The Smartsheet row marks activity alerts as Supported (Alerts and Monitoring only) while the article says Activities is currently not supported for Smartsheet, and the ChatGPT licensing cell reads Not Supported. The article does not explain either.

dropbox-label.title: Whether the Dropbox row's Apply Box Classification Label is intended
dropbox-label.detail: The Dropbox actions row lists a Box classification label action, possibly carried over from the Box row; the article does not say.
